CRIT-TABLA-BAYAN.drill_hint: Speak the pattern aloud (B for bass, dash for no bass) while playing only the bayan strokes, then add the right hand.
CRIT-TABLA-BAYAN.why_it_matters: The source sounds the bayan on 21 of 53 strokes in a fixed pattern (BBB--.B---B-) (CLM-04); where the bass is withheld is part of the cycle's shape.

CRIT-TABLA-COMPLETE.drill_hint: Play one cycle at half speed and count the strokes out loud against the reference count.
CRIT-TABLA-COMPLETE.why_it_matters: The source segment contains 53 strokes on a fixed grid (CLM-02); a dropped or added stroke breaks the phrase.

CRIT-TABLA-STEADY.drill_hint: Play only the pulse on one drum for a minute against a metronome, then add the pattern.
CRIT-TABLA-STEADY.why_it_matters: The source's pulse varies by only 11.3% between strokes (CLM-05).

CRIT-TABLA-TEMPO.drill_hint: Play along with the source segment, counting 2 strokes per beat, then record without it.
CRIT-TABLA-TEMPO.why_it_matters: The source holds a 0.189 s stroke pulse throughout the segment (CLM-01); rushing or dragging changes the rhythm itself.

CRIT-TABLA-TIMING.drill_hint: Loop one cycle slowly with a metronome on the pulse; speed up only when every stroke coincides with the click.
CRIT-TABLA-TIMING.why_it_matters: Every stroke of the source sits on the pulse grid, with a median of 10 ms off it (CLM-02).
